items.title: ECI announces voter-roll revision in four states and two Union Territories
items.text: The Election Commission of India announced a Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls in Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Odisha and Sikkim, along with Chandigarh and Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu. Draft rolls are scheduled for publication on 30 November 2026, and the final rolls on 21 January 2027. The exercise aims to enrol eligible voters, especially young and first-time electors.

items.title: DRDO successfully flight-tests indigenous Pralay quasi-ballistic missile
items.text: The Defence Research and Development Organisation successfully flight-tested the indigenously developed Pralay quasi-ballistic missile from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island off Odisha on 5 November at about 11:10 a.m. The Ministry of Defence said all test objectives were met. Research Centre Imarat in Hyderabad and other DRDO laboratories developed the missile, while Bharat Dynamics Limited produced the system.

items.title: Ministry of Mines offers 20 critical-mineral blocks in its ninth auction tranche
items.text: The Ministry of Mines launched the ninth tranche of the critical and strategic mineral block auction on 5 November, offering 20 blocks. Telangana is among the states included, with three blocks in this tranche. The auction is intended to strengthen domestic access to minerals used in clean energy, electric mobility, electronics, defence and other strategic industries.
items.source: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Mines, 2026-11-05

items.title: UIDAI onboards 300 entities for Aadhaar offline verification
items.text: The Unique Identification Authority of India said it has onboarded 300 Offline Verification Seeking Entities since the Aadhaar App rollout in January. The consent-based, paperless verification framework is being adopted across sectors including hospitality, healthcare, education, events and the gig economy. UIDAI also reported nearly 7.5 crore Aadhaar App downloads.
items.source: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Electronics & IT, 2026-11-05

items.title: India begin SAFF Championship title defence with 3–2 win over Pakistan
items.text: India opened their SAFF Championship 2026 campaign with a 3–2 victory over Pakistan in Dhaka on 5 November. Suhail Ahmad Bhat scored twice in the first half and Manglenthang Kipgen added the third goal. Pakistan scored twice in stoppage time, but India held on to secure all three points.

items.title: Rupee gains support as foreign investors return to Indian equities
items.text: Reuters reported on 6 November that the rupee was supported by renewed foreign investment and a weekly gain of about 0.5%. Foreign investors bought a net US$1.6 billion of Indian shares on Thursday, their largest single-day purchase in nearly six years. Lower oil prices and global technology-market volatility were among the factors shaping the outlook.
